broadcast_ids.description: IDs of the broadcasts that announce the release, at most 100.

description.description: What changes for the people who get the release.

feature_flag_ids.description: IDs of the feature flags that control who gets the release, at most 100.

insight_ids.description: IDs of the saved insights that measure the release, at most 100.

metric_goals.description: Targets for the release's metrics, at most one per metric. Each insight_id must be one of the metric_insight_ids. Replaces the current goals.

direction.description:
at_least when the metric should reach the value, at_most when it should stay at or below it.

* `at_least` - At least the target
* `at_most` - At most the target

insight_id.description: ID of the metric insight the goal is for.

metric_insight_ids.description: IDs of the saved trends insights that are the release's metrics, at most 5. The first is the primary metric, the rest are secondary. Replaces the current list.

owner_id.description: ID of the user who owns the release. Must be a member of the project's organization.

survey_ids.description: IDs of the surveys that collect feedback on the release, at most 100.
